changes.motivation: Remove per-edit linting that ran after every file write, which was noisy and blocked edits on lint errors mid-refactor.
changes.summary: Removed the PostToolUse hook from `.claude/settings.json` that ran `lint.sh` after every Edit/Write tool use.

changes.motivation: Pre-commit YAML was a Nix-store symlink that went stale every time package versions bumped, requiring devshell re-entry to get a valid file. Moving to a committed, PATH-based file makes it stable and version-controlled without depending on generated Nix store paths.
changes.summary: Replaced the symlinked `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (pointing to a Nix store path) with a plain committed file using PATH-based binary names. Added `typecheck-cli`, `lint-cli`, and `test-cli` hooks for the CLI module (previously missing), and added `test-proxy` (also previously missing).

changes.motivation: The bun check scripts (`check-bun-typecheck-cli`, `check-bun-lint-cli`, `check-bun-test-cli`) need to be on PATH for the PATH-based YAML entries to work.
changes.summary: Added `mkBunTypecheck`, `mkBunLint`, and `mkBunTest` scripts for all `bunProjects` to the devshell packages list in `lib/devshell/default.nix`.

changes.motivation: The PATH-based YAML uses `nixfmt` as a bare binary, but `pkgs.nixfmt-rfc-style` was only a transitive dep of the `treefmt` wrapper — not directly on PATH.
changes.summary: Added `pkgs.nixfmt-rfc-style` explicitly to devshell packages in `lib/devshell/default.nix` so `nixfmt` is on PATH for the pre-commit hook.

changes.motivation: The `yamlFormat`/`prekConfig` Nix derivations and the `ln -sfn` shellHook line are now dead code since the YAML is committed directly.
changes.summary: Removed `yamlFormat` and `prekConfig` derivations (~90 lines) and the `ln -sfn ${prekConfig} .pre-commit-config.yaml` shellHook line from `lib/devshell/default.nix`. Updated shellHook comment accordingly.

problems: The Glob tool does not follow symlinks, so `.pre-commit-config.yaml` (a symlink) was not found by Glob and required a Bash `find` fallback. This caused unnecessary confusion before the root cause was identified.

In `lib/devshell/default.nix`, the Nix variable `nixfmt` is a `treefmt.withConfig` wrapper whose binary is `treefmt`, not `nixfmt`. Nothing in the code or comments indicates this — the variable name strongly implies it exposes the `nixfmt` binary. This caused the agent to discover by trial-and-error that `nixfmt` was not on PATH despite appearing to be configured.

After removing `prekConfig`, `checkPackageJson` became an unreferenced derivation (deadnix would flag it), and `check-package-json` was not added to devshell packages, leaving the hook entry in the YAML pointing to a binary that is not on PATH. This was flagged but not fully resolved before the session ended.
